args.body:
File: README.md

Update README.md to use npm start instead of npm run serve, as package.json defines npm start to run node dist/index.js rather than a serve script.
args.title: Update README.md to use npm start instead of npm run serve

args.body:
label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The README.md file lists npm run serve under running locally, but package.json defines npm start to run node dist/index.js instead of a serve script. Updating the documentation to recommend npm start will align the instructions with the actual project configuration.
